_doc: Per-draft overrides for webform-submit.cjs (pitches/webform-failure-buckets-2026-07-10.md). Schema per bucket-doc §'New config schema'. Drop drafts (weedmaps, marijuanaventure, activitymaine, cleangreencertified, kbcannabisconsulting) are NOT included — they're either unfixable or require re-research of the To: URL in the draft markdown, not code changes. For drafts marked 'hands-on inspect' the field_map is empty {} until someone manually inspects the failed-submit screenshot and adds the required field names.

cannacenterofexcellence.org.md._note: Submit button is JS-bound; hands-on inspect required. submit_selectors placeholder until inspect confirms the actual element.

mgmagazine.com.md._note: Likely an embedded contact widget — needs hands-on inspect to identify the actual submit element. extra_selectors.success added per bucket doc.

mgretailer.com.md._note: Sister site to mgmagazine — same embedded widget, same fix path.

cannabiscreative.com.md._note: field_map empty pending hands-on inspect of the failed-submit screenshot to identify the missing required field.

cannabisindustryjournal.com.md._note: Trade publication — almost always requires a Publication/Press Outlet field. field_map covers that + phone explicitly null (often a required honeypot on trade-pub forms).
